svg.title: How Eisen and colleagues showed a clustering
svg.desc: Schematic of Eisen et al., PNAS 95:14863 (1998), Fig. 1. A heat map with one row per gene and one column per time point, red where a gene is above the reference and green where it is below, with the tree of genes at its left. The colors are the paper's, averaged over blocks of about five genes. Only the top of the tree is drawn, down to 24 branches. Five colored bars at the right mark the clusters A to E: cholesterol synthesis, the cell cycle, the immediate-early response, signaling and new blood vessels, and wound healing.
